scenes.sub: Scenarios every operator runs: crypto −50% in a day · a stablecoin depegs 10% · borrow rates spike to 20% · your largest protocol is hacked · your main L2 halts for 48h. For each: loss, liquidations, liquidity, and whether the payout policy survives.

scenes.title: Worked example — $200,000 book
scenes.vo: ETH minus 50%, Spot minus $30k; collateral minus $30k (health factor 4.0 to 2.0, no liquidation); L.P. $20k to $14.1k (minus $5.9k) to minus $65.9k (minus 32.9%), Survives, but the payout must fall. One stablecoin minus 10%, minus $2.5k on $25k, Yes. Borrow rate 20%, Interest on $12k rises from about $600 to $2,400 a year, Yes: covered by reserve. One lending protocol hacked (total loss), minus $25k (minus 12.5%), Survives; cap was 12.5%. layer two halted 48h, Positions frozen; the reserve on another chain covers needs, Yes, if the reserve isn't on the same layer two.

items: Five scenarios run on the current book

Re-run quarterly and after big changes
